sql: SELECT [region] AS [region], SUM([amount]) AS [amount_sum] FROM [sales_fact] WHERE [amount] > @p1 GROUP BY [region] ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM([amount]) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, SUM([amount]) DESC, CASE WHEN [region] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, [region] ASC OFFSET @p2 ROWS FETCH NEXT @p3 ROWS ONLY
